blocks.text: Faqat ikkita haqida: both, neither, either

**both, neither, either** — faqat **ikkita** narsa yoki odam haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi (→ qizil kitob, 82-dars). Ikkitadan ko'p bo'lsa, ularning o'rniga **all, none, any** keladi (→ 88-dars): **both** my parents (ikkala ota-onam), lekin **all** my cousins (hamma amakivachchalarim). O'zbekchada ma'nolari: **both** — «ikkalasi ham», **neither** — «hech biri», **either** — «istalgani, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham» yoki inkorda «hech biri». Eng muhim nozik farq — otning soni: **both** dan keyin ot **ko'plikda**, **neither** va **either** dan keyin esa **birlikda**: both **rooms**, lekin neither **room**, either **room**.
neither yoki not ... either — bitta inkor

**neither** o'zi inkor so'z, shuning uchun undan keyin fe'l **darak** shaklda keladi: **Neither** answer **is** correct. Agar fe'l inkor bo'lsa, **either** ishlatiladi: I **don't** like **either** of them = I like **neither** of them. O'zbekcha «Ikkalasi ham yoqmadi» yoki «Hech biri to'g'ri **emas**» dagi inkor inglizchaga neither bilan birga o'tmaydi (→ 86-dars). Darak gapda **either** — «istalgani»: Sit on **either** chair. **either side / either end** esa ko'pincha «ikkala tomonida» ma'nosida: trees on **either** side of the road.

items.text: **Neither** restaurant was open, so we cooked at home.
items.translation: **Hech bir** restoran ochiq emas edi, shuning uchun uyda ovqat pishirdik.

items.text: We **didn't** like **either** restaurant, to be honest.
There are cafés on **either** side of the square.

blocks.text: both of, neither of, either of

Aniq ikkita narsa haqida **of** + the / my / these / those yoki olmosh keladi: **neither of** the hotels, **either of** my brothers, **both of** them. **both** dan keyin the / my oldidan of tushib qolishi mumkin: **both (of) the** hotels, **both (of) my** brothers. **neither** va **either** bilan esa ot oldidan of shart (neither of the hotels), olmoshdan oldin esa uchalasi ham of talab qiladi: both **of** us, neither **of** them. **neither of / either of** + ko'plikdagi otdan keyin fe'l rasmiy uslubda birlikda (Neither of them **is** ready), so'zlashuvda ko'pincha ko'plikda (Neither of them **are** ready).

items.text: **Both of** my grandparents were teachers in Bukhara.
items.translation: Bobom ham, buvim ham — **ikkalasi ham** Buxoroda o'qituvchi bo'lgan.

items.text: Can **either of** you help me move this sofa?
items.translation: **Ikkalangizdan biringiz** bu divanni surishga yordam bera olasizmi?

items.text: Tom and Kate **are both** doctors, but **neither of them** works in a hospital.
items.translation: Tom va Keyt **ikkalasi ham** shifokor, lekin ularning **hech biri** shifoxonada ishlamaydi.

blocks.text: both ... and, neither ... nor, either ... or

Uchala so'z juft bog'lovchi sifatida ham keladi: **both** A **and** B — «ham A, ham B»; **neither** A **nor** B — «na A, na B»; **either** A **or** B — «yo A, yo B». Juftlikning ikkala qismi bir xil turdagi so'z bo'lishi kerak: both **interesting** and **useful** (ikkalasi sifat), either **by bus** or **by train**. **neither ... nor** dan keyin fe'l yana **darak** shaklda: She **speaks** neither English nor French. **neither ... nor** va **either ... or** bilan ega bo'lsa, fe'l **eng yaqin egaga** moslashadi: Neither Tom nor his parents **are** at home; Either the parents or the teacher **has** to sign.

items.text: The new phone is **both** cheaper **and** faster than the old one.
**Neither** Aziz **nor** Bekzod knows how to change a tyre.
We can meet **either** at the café **or** at my office — you choose.
items.translation: **Yo** kafeda, **yo** mening ofisimda uchrashishimiz mumkin — o'zingiz tanlang.

blocks.text: Qisqa javobda uchala so'z yolg'iz keladi: Tea or coffee? — **Either** (farqi yo'q). / **Neither**, thanks (hech birini xohlamayman). / **Both**, please! Boshqa birovning inkor gapiga qo'shilish — **Neither do I** / **Me neither** — qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 42-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Neither answer isn't correct» → **Neither** answer **is** correct (bitta inkor); «both rooms has / neither rooms» → both rooms **have**, neither **room** (son farqi); «both of hotels» → **both (of) the** hotels yoki **both** hotels; «both of we» → **both of us** / **we both**; uchta va undan ko'p narsa uchun «both / neither» → **all / none** (Uchala akam ham → **All** my three brothers).
Tanlashdan oldin sanang: **ikkita**mi? Ha bo'lsa — both / neither / either. Keyin fe'lga qarang: fe'l inkor (don't, can't) bo'lsa — **either**, darak bo'lsa va ma'no «hech biri» — **neither**.

rows: both / neither / either of + the / them
both ... and / neither ... nor / either ... or
ham ... ham / na ... na / yo ... yo

examples.title: **both** + plural, **neither** / **either** + singular
examples.description: both + ko'plikdagi ot (ikkalasi ham), neither + birlikdagi ot (hech biri), either + birlikdagi ot (istalgani). either side — «ikkala tomonida».

sentences.text: **Both** hospitals in our town have excellent children's departments.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizdagi **ikkala** shifoxonada ham ajoyib bolalar bo'limi bor.

sentences.text: **Neither** candidate gave a clear answer about taxes during the debate.
sentences.translation: Munozarada nomzodlarning **hech biri** soliqlar haqida aniq javob bermadi.

sentences.text: You can pay at **either** desk — they're both open now.
sentences.translation: **Istalgan** kassada to'lashingiz mumkin — ikkalasi ham hozir ochiq.

sentences.text: My parents were born in Samarkand, so **both** sides of my family speak Tajik.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Samarqandda tug'ilgan, shuning uchun oilamning **ikkala** tomoni ham tojikcha gapiradi.

sentences.text: **Neither** answer is correct, so read the question again.
sentences.translation: **Ikkala javob ham** noto'g'ri, savolni qaytadan o'qing.

sentences.text: There are small shops on **either** side of the street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chaning **ikkala** tomonida ham kichik do'konlar bor.

sentences.text: **Both** my brothers work in IT, but in different companies.
sentences.translation: **Ikkala** akam ham IT sohasida ishlaydi, lekin turli kompaniyalarda.

sentences.text: I tried two pharmacies, and **neither** shop had the medicine I needed.
sentences.translation: Ikkita dorixonaga kirdim, lekin **hech birida** menga kerakli dori yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Would you like tea or coffee? — **Either** is fine, thanks.
sentences.translation: Choy ichasizmi yoki qahva? — **Qaysi biri bo'lsa ham** bo'laveradi, rahmat.

sentences.text: James broke **both** legs skiing, so he'll be on crutches for months.
sentences.translation: Jeyms chang'i uchayotib **ikkala** oyog'ini ham sindirdi, endi oylab qo'ltiqtayoq bilan yuradi.

examples.title: **neither** or not ... **either**: one negative
examples.description: neither = not ... either. Fe'l darak shaklda bo'lsa — neither, inkor shaklda bo'lsa — either. O'zbekchadagidek ikki inkor yo'q.

sentences.text: I've read both reports, but I **don't** agree with **either** of them.
sentences.translation: Ikkala hisobotni ham o'qidim, lekin ularning **birortasiga ham qo'shilmayman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza tried on two dresses, but she liked **neither** of them.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ikkita ko'ylakni kiyib ko'rdi, lekin ularning **hech biri** unga **yoqmadi**.

sentences.text: There are two buses to the airport, but **neither** runs after midnight.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga ikkita avtobus boradi, lekin yarim tundan keyin **hech biri yurmaydi**.

sentences.text: We **didn't** visit **either** museum because they were both closed on Monday.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni ikkalasi ham yopiq bo'lgani uchun **hech bir** muzeyga **bormadik**.

sentences.text: **Neither** of my grandparents could read English, but they loved British films.
sentences.translation: Bobom ham, buvim ham inglizcha o'qiy **olmasdi**, lekin ikkalasi ingliz filmlarini yaxshi ko'rardi.

sentences.text: Tom **can't** speak **either** French or German, so he's taking lessons.
sentences.translation: Tom fransuzcha ham, nemischa ham **gapira olmaydi**, shuning uchun darsga qatnayapti.

sentences.text: **Neither** of the twins wanted to go to bed early.
sentences.translation: Egizaklarning **hech biri** erta yotishni **xohlamadi**.

sentences.text: The two chargers look the same, but **neither** fits my phone.
sentences.translation: Ikkala quvvatlagich bir xil ko'rinadi, lekin **hech biri** telefonimga **to'g'ri kelmaydi**.

sentences.text: Kate phoned both her sisters, but she **couldn't** reach **either** of them.
sentences.translation: Keyt ikkala singlisiga qo'ng'iroq qildi, lekin **birortasi bilan ham bog'lana olmadi**.

sentences.text: Which hotel did you choose in the end? — **Neither**. We stayed with friends.
sentences.translation: Oxiri qaysi mehmonxonani tanladingiz? — **Hech birini**. Do'stlarnikida qoldik.

examples.title: **both of** / **neither of** / **either of** + the, my
examples.description: Aniq ikkita narsa haqida — of + the / my / these / those. both dan keyin of tushib qolishi mumkin (both the, both my), neither va either bilan ot oldidan of shart.

sentences.text: **Both of** the flights to Istanbul were delayed by the snow.
sentences.translation: Istanbulga **ikkala** reys ham qor tufayli kechikdi.

sentences.text: **Neither of** my parents has a driving licence, so they take taxis everywhere.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning **hech birida** haydovchilik guvohnomasi yo'q, shuning uchun hamma joyga taksida borishadi.

sentences.text: You can take **either of** these roads — they both lead to the lake.
sentences.translation: Bu yo'llarning **istalganidan** borishingiz mumkin — ikkalasi ham ko'lga olib boradi.

sentences.text: I've met **both** Madina's brothers, and they're very funny.
sentences.translation: Madinaning **ikkala** akasi bilan ham tanishganman, ular juda quvnoq.

sentences.text: **Neither of** the hotels near the station has a lift.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinidagi mehmonxonalarning **hech birida** lift yo'q.

sentences.text: Has **either of** your children been to London? — Yes, my daughter has.
sentences.translation: Farzandlaringizdan **birortasi** Londonda bo'lganmi? — Ha, qizim bo'lgan.

sentences.text: **Both** the chairs in the kitchen are broken, so please sit on the sofa.
sentences.translation: Oshxonadagi **ikkala** stul ham singan, iltimos, divanga o'tiring.

sentences.text: The doctor examined **both of** my knees and said **neither of** them was seriously injured.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **ikkala** tizzamni ham ko'rib, ularning **hech biri** jiddiy shikastlanmaganini aytdi.

sentences.text: If **either of** the printers stops working, call the IT department.
sentences.translation: Printerlarning **birortasi** ishlamay qolsa, IT bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Aziz invited **both of** his business partners to the wedding, but **neither of** them came.
sentences.translation: Aziz to'yga **ikkala** sherigini ham taklif qildi, lekin ularning **hech biri** kelmadi.

examples.title: With pronouns: **both of us**, **we both**, **neither of them**
examples.description: Olmosh bilan of shart: both of us, neither of them, either of you. both egadan keyin ham keladi: we both, they both; be va yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: they are both, we have both.

sentences.text: **Both of us** grew up in Fergana, but we met in London.
sentences.translation: **Ikkalamiz** ham Farg'onada o'sganmiz, lekin Londonda tanishganmiz.

sentences.text: **We both** love hiking, so we spend most weekends in the mountains.
sentences.translation: **Ikkalamiz** ham piyoda sayrni yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun dam olish kunlarining ko'pini tog'da o'tkazamiz.

sentences.text: My sisters **are both** teachers, just like our mother.
sentences.translation: Opa-singillarim **ikkalasi ham** xuddi onamiz kabi o'qituvchi.

sentences.text: I asked Tom and Oliver for help, but **neither of them** had time.
sentences.translation: Tom va Oliverdan yordam so'radim, lekin **ikkalasining ham** vaqti yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Can **either of you** give me a lift to the station?
sentences.translation: **Birortangiz** meni vokzalgacha olib borib qo'ya olasizmi?

sentences.text: The children **have both** caught a cold, so they're staying at home today.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **ikkalasi ham** shamollab qolishdi, shuning uchun bugun uyda.

sentences.text: **Neither of us** knew the way, so we used the map on my phone.
sentences.translation: **Hech birimiz** yo'lni **bilmasdik**, shuning uchun telefonimdagi xaritadan foydalandik.

sentences.text: Sarah and Emma **both** work for the BBC, but in different departments.
sentences.translation: Sara va Emma **ikkalasi ham** BBC da ishlaydi, lekin turli bo'limlarda.

sentences.text: I've got two cousins in Oxford, and I'm going to visit **both of them** in May.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda ikkita amakivachcham bor, may oyida **ikkalasini ham** ko'rgani boraman.

sentences.text: Your sons are lovely — **neither of them** has ever been rude to me.
sentences.translation: O'g'illaringiz juda yoqimli — **hech biri** menga hech qachon qo'pollik qilmagan.

examples.title: **both ... and**, **neither ... nor**
examples.description: Ikki narsani bog'lash: both ... and — «ham ..., ham ...», neither ... nor — «na ..., na ...» (fe'l darak shaklda!). neither ... nor dan keyin fe'l eng yaqin egaga moslashadi.

sentences.text: The course was **both** interesting **and** useful for my job.
sentences.translation: Kurs **ham** qiziqarli, **ham** ishim uchun foydali bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Neither** Jasur **nor** his wife speaks English, so I translated for them.
sentences.translation: **Na** Jasur, **na** uning xotini inglizcha gapiradi, shuning uchun ularga tarjima qildim.

sentences.text: **Both** Oxford **and** Cambridge offered Madina a place.
sentences.translation: Madinaga **ham** Oksford, **ham** Kembrij o'qishga joy taklif qildi.

sentences.text: The hotel was **neither** clean **nor** cheap, so we left after one night.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona **na** toza, **na** arzon edi, shuning uchun bir kechadan keyin ketdik.

sentences.text: She **both** writes **and** illustrates her own children's books.
sentences.translation: U bolalar kitoblarini **ham** o'zi yozadi, **ham** rasmlarini o'zi chizadi.

sentences.text: **Neither** the manager **nor** the staff **were** told about the changes.
sentences.translation: O'zgarishlar haqida **na** menejerga, **na** xodimlarga aytildi.

sentences.text: I've lived **both** in the city **and** in the countryside, and I prefer the city.
sentences.translation: **Ham** shaharda, **ham** qishloqda yashaganman, shaharni afzal ko'raman.

sentences.text: My phone has **neither** a good camera **nor** enough memory.
sentences.translation: Telefonimda **na** yaxshi kamera, **na** yetarli xotira bor.

sentences.text: This job requires **both** patience **and** a good sense of humour.
sentences.translation: Bu ish **ham** sabr, **ham** yaxshi hazil tuyg'usini talab qiladi.

sentences.text: **Neither** the bus **nor** the train goes directly to the village, so you'll need a taxi.
sentences.translation: Qishloqqa **na** avtobus, **na** poyezd to'g'ridan-to'g'ri boradi, shuning uchun taksi kerak bo'ladi.

examples.title: **either ... or**: a choice between two
examples.description: either ... or — «yo ..., yo ...», ikki imkoniyatdan biri. Inkorda: not ... either ... or = neither ... nor. Ega bo'lsa, fe'l eng yaqin egaga moslashadi.

sentences.text: We can **either** take a taxi **or** walk — it's only fifteen minutes.
sentences.translation: **Yo** taksi olamiz, **yo** piyoda boramiz — atigi o'n besh daqiqalik yo'l.

sentences.text: **Either** you apologise to your sister, **or** you stay at home tonight.
sentences.translation: **Yo** singlingdan kechirim so'raysan, **yo** bugun kechqurun uyda qolasan.

sentences.text: At the museum shop you can pay **either** in cash **or** by bank transfer.
sentences.translation: Muzey do'konida **yo** naqd pul bilan, **yo** bank o'tkazmasi orqali to'lashingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: The meeting will be **either** on Tuesday **or** on Thursday — I'll let you know.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **yo** seshanba, **yo** payshanba kuni bo'ladi — sizga xabar beraman.

sentences.text: **Either** Bekzod **or** his brother is going to pick us up from the airport.
sentences.translation: Bizni aeroportdan **yo** Bekzod, **yo** akasi olib ketadi.

sentences.text: I **don't** eat **either** meat **or** fish — I'm a vegetarian.
sentences.translation: Men go'sht **ham**, baliq **ham yemayman** — vegetarianman.

sentences.text: She's **either** at the library **or** at the gym — she's never at home on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: U **yo** kutubxonada, **yo** sport zalida — shanba kunlari hech qachon uyda bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: You'll have to choose: **either** a new car **or** a holiday in Japan.
sentences.translation: Tanlashingiz kerak bo'ladi: **yo** yangi mashina, **yo** Yaponiyada dam olish.

sentences.text: **Either** the battery is dead **or** the charger isn't working.
sentences.translation: **Yo** batareya o'tirib qolgan, **yo** quvvatlagich ishlamayapti.

sentences.text: Students can **either** live in a hall of residence **or** rent a private flat in the city.
sentences.translation: Talabalar **yo** yotoqxonada yashashlari, **yo** shahardan alohida kvartira ijaraga olishlari mumkin.

examples.title: Dialogue: two job offers
examples.description: Ikki do'st ikkita ish taklifi haqida gaplashadi: both, neither, either — ot bilan, of bilan va yolg'iz.

sentences.text: — I've got two job offers, and I have to answer **both** companies by Friday.
sentences.translation: — Ikkita ish taklifi oldim, juma kunigacha **ikkala** kompaniyaga ham javob berishim kerak.

sentences.text: — Congratulations! Are **both of** them here in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: — Tabriklayman! **Ikkalasi ham** shu yerda, Toshkentdami?

sentences.text: — No, **neither** is in Tashkent: one is in Samarkand and the other is in London.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **hech biri** Toshkentda emas: biri Samarqandda, ikkinchisi Londonda.

sentences.text: — Wow! Which one pays better, or are they **both** the same?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Qaysi biri yaxshiroq maosh beradi yoki **ikkalasi** bir xilmi?

sentences.text: — The London job pays more, but **neither** salary is huge, to be honest.
sentences.translation: — Londondagisi ko'proq to'laydi, lekin rostini aytsam, **hech biridagi** maosh juda katta emas.

sentences.text: — Do your parents want you to take **either of** them in particular?
sentences.translation: — Ota-onang ulardan aynan **birortasini** tanlashingni xohlaydimi?

sentences.text: — My mum wants me to stay close, and my dad is happy **either** way.
sentences.translation: — Onam yaqinda qolishimni xohlaydi, otam esa **qaysi biri bo'lsa ham** rozi.

sentences.text: — Honestly, you'd be happy in **either** city — they're **both** beautiful.
sentences.translation: — Rostini aytsam, **ikkala** shaharda ham baxtli bo'lasan — **ikkalasi ham** go'zal.

sentences.text: — I know. I'll **either** call them tomorrow **or** think about it for another day.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Ertaga **yo** ularga qo'ng'iroq qilaman, **yo** yana bir kun o'ylab ko'raman.

sentences.text: — Good luck! **Neither** choice is wrong, so don't worry too much.
sentences.translation: — Omad! **Hech qaysi** tanlov xato emas, shuning uchun ko'p qayg'urma.

examples.title: Mixed: **both**, **neither**, **either** in real life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: both, neither, either — ot bilan, of bilan, olmosh bilan va juft bog'lovchilar sifatida.

sentences.text: **Both** candidates promised lower taxes, but **neither** explained how to pay for it.
sentences.translation: **Ikkala** nomzod ham soliqlarni kamaytirishni va'da qildi, lekin **hech biri** buning pulini qayerdan olishni tushuntirmadi.

sentences.text: There are two entrances to the stadium, and fans can use **either** of them.
sentences.translation: Stadionga ikkita kirish joyi bor, muxlislar ulardan **istalganidan** foydalanishi mumkin.

sentences.text: **Neither** my sister **nor** I inherited our father's talent for music.
sentences.translation: Otamizning musiqiy iste'dodi **na** opamga, **na** menga o'tdi.

sentences.text: Nilufar speaks **both** English **and** Korean fluently, so the company sent her to Seoul.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **ham** ingliz, **ham** koreys tilida ravon gapiradi, shuning uchun kompaniya uni Seulga yubordi.

sentences.text: We looked round two flats yesterday, but **neither of** them had enough light.
sentences.translation: Kecha ikkita kvartirani ko'rdik, lekin ularning **hech birida** yetarli yorug'lik yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Hold the box with **both** hands — it's heavier than it looks.
sentences.translation: Qutini **ikkala** qo'lingiz bilan ushlang — u ko'rinishidan og'irroq.

sentences.text: The report was **either** badly translated **or** badly written — I couldn't understand a word.
sentences.translation: Hisobot **yo** yomon tarjima qilingan, **yo** yomon yozilgan — bir so'zini ham tushunmadim.

sentences.text: Are you free on Saturday or Sunday? — I'm afraid I'm busy on **both** days.
sentences.translation: Shanba yoki yakshanba bo'shmisiz? — Afsuski, **ikkala** kuni ham bandman.

sentences.text: **Neither of** the two printers in the office works, so we have to print everything at home.
sentences.translation: Ofisdagi ikkita printerning **hech biri** ishlamaydi, shuning uchun hammasini uyda chop etishga majburmiz.

sentences.text: Jasur couldn't choose between the two laptops, so in the end he bought **neither** and kept his old one.
sentences.translation: Jasur ikkita noutbukdan birini tanlay olmadi va oxiri **hech birini olmay**, eskisida qoldi.
